review_process.parent: GPT-6 Astra coordinating source integration and visual checks
review_process.independence: Shared parent context and source facts; correlated computational reviews, not independent human, chemical or laboratory validation. Source objections override agreement.

adjudications.objection: The printed product parameter is Yield, not the literal phrase isolated yield.
adjudications.resolution: Keep the source label Yield and state explicitly that isolated_yield is classified from the preparative purification workflow. No reinterpretation of the reported 50 scalar.

adjudications.objection: The supplement does not name UniProt Q05514.
adjudications.resolution: Reference accession association is explicitly through UniProt and its Raj2012 citation; no exact assayed sequence or tag-free construct substitution.

adjudications.objection: A low-resolution review read p25 as a single forward arrow.
adjudications.resolution: High-resolution direct visual inspection reveals opposing arrows. Reviewer retracted the single-arrow reading. Store opposing_arrows_as_drawn and explicitly withhold equilibrium/reverse-rate inference.

adjudications.objection: A threo-DL retention pair does not establish the enzymatic configuration or exact selectivity.
adjudications.resolution: Keep enzymatic ee/de and absolute configuration null, preserve only the qualitative publisher abstract at its own scope. No other product selectivity transfers.

adjudications.objection: Q73A/L384A inactivity has data not shown and no specified assay.
adjudications.resolution: Keep author-statement context with null scalar, assay, substrates and uncertainty; no measured zero, combinatorial mechanism, epistasis value or geometry cause.
Parent text/visual check locates1j on PDF/printed p22; all packet locators corrected.

blocked_operations: Exact enzymatic ee/de or absolute-configuration assignment from inspected4j entry
Wild-type or double-mutant numerical comparison for4j
Microscopic mechanism, exact reacting geometry or M0468 catalytic-role transfer
Exact assayed sequence or preparation authentication
Protected registry expansion or exact-reaction-instance admission
remaining_limits: Main article body uninspected; source named constructs only; no exact enzymatic selectivity or assay for the double-mutant statement. These do not block the source-reported conversion and yield annotation.
